subject: context/cross-task-relevance
statement: Cross-task durable knowledge must not enter C3 context projection on a weak lexical coincidence alone. Explicit scope/path/same-task signals remain authoritative; lexical-only matches from another task require multiple overlapping query terms and supporting overlap with the source task goal.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Implement R6.2 Cognitive Hardening from fresh-model dogfood: cross-task context relevance, research source awareness, and material open-question awareness.
